<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914911_theRebbe_655" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914911_theRebbe_655__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through joy in performing mitzvos, including all actions for the sake of Heaven, the boundaries of exile are breached, bringing Moshiach and the faithful shepherd of every generation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">A)</t>
    <t s="2">And through the joy in performing the mitzvah,</t>
    <t s="3">including also the fulfillment of the command,</t>
    <t s="4">and all</t>
    <t s="5">your deeds should be for the sake of Heaven, and in all</t>
    <t s="6">your ways know Him,</t>
    <t s="7">they will breach the barriers of the exile,</t>
    <t s="8">and with me, from there, the King Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="9">Dovid King of Israel,</t>
    <t s="10">together with Moshe Rabbeinu, the Faithful Shepherd,</t>
    <t s="11">for the first redeemer is the final redeemer,</t>
    <t s="12">including also the Faithful Shepherd in every generation, until the Faithful Shepherd of our generation, namely the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Nasi of our generation.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Very soon the promise will be fulfilled that the dwellers of dust will awaken and sing, and together with them we will go to greet Moshiach with eternal joy.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">That very soon the promise will be fulfilled: "Awake and sing, you who dwell in dust,"</t>
    <t s="1">and together with them we will go to greet our righteous Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="2">and "everlasting joy upon their heads,"</t>
    <t s="3">speedily in our days, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
